searchPlaceholder: Search an app name, e.g. WeChat, Spotify
tip: Left click inserts at the cursor; right click to set as document icon or download only
noEditor: Saved $1, but no document is open so it cannot be inserted
noDocId: No document found, cannot set the icon
setCountryDesc: App Store region selected by default when opening the panel
setRoundedDesc: Round the square artwork to match SiYuan's other icons
setRecentDesc: How many recently used icons to show on top. 0 disables it.
setBreadcrumbDesc: Show a shortcut button in the document breadcrumb bar
setStatusBarDesc: Show an icon button at the right of the bottom status bar
busyTip: The previous action is still running
